name: Twilight Meditation
description:
When the character to which this is attached used a Normal Attack: Physical DMG dealt is converted to Electro DMG, DMG +1, Unaligned Element cost -1, and deal 1 Piercing DMG to the opposing character with the lowest HP.
Duration (Rounds): 2
